from pathlib import Path
folder=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u036/system/state/workspace/programs')
folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p=folder/'task-4a345991.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The colored sequence along the top edge gives the vertical ray columns.
    sources = [(0, c, grid[0][c]) for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != 0]
    for sr, sc, color in sources:
        targets = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                   if grid[r][c] == color and (r, c) != (sr, sc)]
        if targets:
            tr, tc = targets[0]
            for r in range(min(sr, tr), max(sr, tr) + 1):
                out[r][sc] = color
            for c in range(min(sc, tc), max(sc, tc) + 1):
                out[tr][c] = color
        else:
            for r in range(h):
                out[r][sc] = color
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(p), 'exec'),globals())
